script: Emperor penguins can dive deeper than 500 meters. They can hold their breath for over 20 minutes. They slow their heart rate to save oxygen on long dives. On land, they huddle in huge groups to survive the Antarctic winter. The fathers keep the egg warm on their feet for about two months. They are the largest penguins, standing over a meter tall.
